Comprehension:Read the passage and answer the given questions.Since the world has become industrialised, the number of animal species that have either become extinct or are nearing extinction has increased. The Bengal tiger, for instance, which once roamed the jungle in vast numbers, now has a population of only 2,300. By the year 2025, this number is projected to drop to zero. What is particularly alarming about the case of the Bengal tiger is that its extinction will have been caused almost entirely by poachers who, according to some sources, are motivated not by material gain but by personal gratification. This reflects a disturbing level of callousness that contributes significantly to the problem of extinction. Animals like the Bengal tiger, along with other endangered species, are vital components of the world’s ecosystem. International laws protecting these animals must be enacted and enforced to ensure their survival and, ultimately, the survival of our planet.Countries around the world have begun to address the problem in various ways. Some nations, in an effort to circumvent the issue, have allocated large areas of land for animal reserves. They charge admission to help defray the costs of maintaining these parks and often rely on support from international organisations as well. With the funds they receive, they can invest in equipment and patrols to protect the animals. Another solution aimed at stemming the tide of animal extinction is an international boycott of products made from endangered species. This measure appears to be fairly effective, but it will not, on its own, prevent animals from being hunted and killed.Which of the following is the most appropriate summary of the passage?
options: The passage describes how Bengal tigers have adapted to industrialised environments.
The passage focuses on the economic benefits of animal reserves and tourism.
The passage discusses the extinction of animals, particularly the Bengal tiger, due to human activities and highlights the need for global action to protect endangered species.
The passage explains the life cycle of endangered species in natural habitats.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (The passage discusses the extinction of animals, particularly the Bengal tiger, due to human activities and highlights the need for global action to protect endangered species.) है।

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Critical theory of technology is a political theory of modernity with a normative dimension. It comes from a tradition extending from Marx to Foucault and Habermas which says that advances in the formal claims of human rights take centre stage. Marx attributed this trajectory to the capitalist rationalisation of production. It is prevalent in every modern political system. This trajectory arose from the problems of control over a disempowered and deskilled labour force; but everywhere it is organised — be it Foucault's prisons or Habermas's public sphere — the same pattern prevails. Technological design is shaped by this pattern as the material base of a distinctive social order. In accordance with the notion of thought, critical theory of technology regards technologies as an environment rather than as a collection of tools. We are surrounded by technologies that determine our way of life. The  theory builds an approach on the lessons of these histories. In this respect, they are comparable to laws and customs. These institutions said to represent those who live under their sway through privileging certain dimensions of their human nature. Laws of property represent the interest in ownership. Customs like parental authority represent the interest of childhood in safety and growth. Interests, such as these constitute the version of human nature sanctioned by society. The concept of nature suggests an alternative. The reference here is, of course, not to the nature of natural science, but to the lived nature in which we find ourselves and which we are. Select the statement which is INCORRECT according to the passage.172
options: The importance of parental authority in ensuring children's safety does not necessarily indicate that such authority is an inherent characteristic of human nature.
The critical theory of technology suggests that as concerns regarding human rights gain attention, we overlook how the social structure tends to become increasingly authoritarian.
Examinations of technologies should incorporate their social backgrounds in order to uncover both the obvious and underlying significance they hold for us.
Technologies aim to elevate specific aspects of human nature, often at a significant expense to the natural world we experience.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Technologies aim to elevate specific aspects of human nature, often at a significant expense to the natural world we experience.) है।

A new exhibition at the Huntington Library, Art Museum and Botanical Gardens, just outside of Los Angeles, entitled Storm Cloud: Picturing the Origins of Our Climate Crisis, helps to trace the scientific, historical and artistic record back to the beginnings of the Industrial Revolution.  One early witness to the changing hues of the countryside's once clear skies and untouched landscape was the British-American painter Thomas Cole (1801-1848). In 1839, he travelled to Portage Falls on the Genesee River in upstate New York to document the sublime vistas, rocky cliffs and abundant foliage surrounding the deep gorge through which the river flowed. Cole's task, commissioned by the New York State Canal Commissioner, was to preserve in oil paint the view about to be destroyed by the forthcoming construction of a new canal that would build on the success of the Erie Canal, which had opened in 1825. Cole, who was known for his monumental landscapes, produced a giant-sized vision of nature's splendour on a canvas that stands 7 ft (2.1 m) tall and 5 ft (1.5 m) wide.What historical event is mentioned as a factor contributing to the environmental changes depicted by Thomas Cole?

Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.The global shift towards renewable energy is reshaping the energy landscape and addressing urgent environmental challenges. Solar, wind, and hydropower are leading the way as sustainable alternatives to fossil fuels, offering significant benefits such as reducing greenhouse gas emissions and slowing climate change. Advancements in technology have dramatically lowered the costs of renewable energy production, making it more accessible and attractive to governments, businesses, and individuals. Countries worldwide are setting ambitious targets to expand their renewable energy capacities, driven by environmental imperatives and the economic opportunities presented by the green energy sector.However, the transition to renewable energy is not without obstacles. One major challenge is energy storage. Since solar and wind power depend on weather conditions, their intermittent nature makes it difficult to ensure a steady energy supply. Developing efficient, scalable, and affordable storage solutions, such as advanced battery systems, is critical to overcoming this hurdle. Additionally, integrating renewable energy into existing power grids requires substantial infrastructure upgrades to manage fluctuating power inputs effectively.Despite these challenges, the momentum behind renewable energy continues to grow. Innovations like floating solar farms, offshore wind farms, and green hydrogen are expanding the boundaries of what renewable technologies can achieve. Furthermore, policy support, public awareness, and private investment are driving the adoption of clean energy at an unprecedented pace. As these advancements unfold, renewable energy is poised to redefine the future of global energy systems, paving the way for a cleaner, more sustainable, and resilient world.How does the passage connect to global developments?
options: It discusses the environmental drawbacks of energy storage solutions.
It emphasises the role of renewable energy in combating climate change.
It explains the effect of renewable energy on rural development.
It highlights how renewable energy impacts global trade in fossil fuels.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (It emphasises the role of renewable energy in combating climate change.) है।

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.After dinner, all the gang turned out to hunt for turtle eggs on the bar. They went about poking sticks into the sand, and when they found a soft place, they went down on their knees and dug with their hands. Sometimes they would take fifty or sixty eggs out of one hole. They were perfectly round, white things, a trifle smaller than an English walnut. They had a famous fried-egg feast that night, and another on Friday morning. After breakfast they went whooping and prancing out of the bar, and chased each other round and round, shedding clothes as they went, until they were naked, and then continued the frolic far away up the shoal water of the bar, against the stiff current, which later tripped their legs from under them from time to time, and greatly increased the fun. And now and then, they stood in a group and splashed water in each other's faces with their palms, gradually approaching each other with averted faces, to avoid the stagging sprays, and finally gripping and struggling till the best man ducked his neighbour, and then they all went under in a tangle of white legs and arms, and came up blowing, sputtering, laughing, and gasping for breath at one and the same time.Select the summary that best captures the essence of the given passage.
options: The passage explains the process of cooking turtle eggs.
The passage describes a group of people enjoying a playful night and morning, hunting for turtle eggs and engaging in fun water activities.
The passage warns about the risks of playing in water.
The passage discusses the dangers of hunting turtle eggs.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (The passage describes a group of people enjoying a playful night and morning, hunting for turtle eggs and engaging in fun water activities.) है।

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow. By mid-2025, the global water crisis is expected to reach unprecedented levels. According to the 2024 UN World Water Development Report, approximately 2.2 billion people lack access to safely managed drinking water, and 3.5 billion lack safely managed sanitation services. Meanwhile, nearly half of the world’s population experiences severe water scarcity for at least part of each year. Agriculture consumes about 70% of global freshwater withdrawals, while industry and municipal use account for roughly 20% and 12%, respectively. Climate change is further destabilizing the hydrological cycle. Rising temperatures, glacial melt, and changing precipitation patterns are reducing freshwater availability, while floods and droughts increase in frequency and severity. Coastal aquifers face growing salinization: studies show that by 2100, as much as 77% of coastal aquifers could be affected by saltwater intrusion due to sea-level rise and declining recharge. Water scarcity today already affects 40% of the global population, and demand is expected to surpass supply by 40% by 2030. Groundwater depletion continues, especially in densely populated regions like India, China, and Pakistan, where aquifer recharge lags behind extraction. Many megacities now face “Day Zero” scenarios, where municipal taps could run dry without drastic conservation and infrastructure reform. While innovative technologies—such as biodegradable hydrogels that extract water from the air—offer promise for remote or water-stressed regions, current investments fall significantly short of what's needed (a shortfall of $85 billion per year) to achieve universal access by 2030. Experts warn that without coordinated global investment, transparent governance, equitable distribution, and water-efficient infrastructure, the world risks escalating conflict, agricultural collapse, economic instability, and public health crises on a global scale.What is the tone of the passage?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Data-driven and urgent) है।

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Patrick Brady’s Chaos TheoryPatrick Brady’s interpretation of Chaos Theory explores the idea that life, much like certain systems in nature, is unpredictable, non-linear, and sensitive to initial conditions. Drawing from the scientific principles of chaos theory — where small changes in starting points can lead to vastly different outcomes — Brady applies this framework metaphorically to human behaviour, relationships, and societal systems.According to Brady, the essence of chaos lies not in disorder, but in complex patterns that emerge from seemingly random events. He emphasises that what appears chaotic on the surface may actually follow an underlying logic or structure. In human contexts, this means that people’s actions, while unpredictable, are not without meaning or influence. A minor decision or an unintended comment can spiral into profound consequences, much like the 'butterfly effect' in classical chaos theory.Brady also connects this theory to creativity and neurodiversity, arguing that unconventional minds often thrive in chaotic environments where flexibility and novel thinking are assets. In this view, chaos is not something to fear but a space where growth, innovation, and transformation become possible. It challenges rigid systems and forces us to reevaluate our assumptions about control, stability, and predictability.Ultimately, Patrick Brady’s chaos theory is not just a scientific metaphor but a philosophical lens — urging us to embrace uncertainty, recognise interconnectedness, and remain open to unexpected outcomes. In doing so, we learn to value the beauty and potential within chaos, especially in a world increasingly defined by complexity and rapid change.Which statement best captures the underlying assumption in Patrick Brady’s view of chaos as applied to human behaviour?
options: Human lives are completely random and without structure.
People should avoid unpredictable situations to ensure success.
Seemingly small actions can have profound and lasting effects.
Predicting behaviour is possible if we analyse every detail.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Seemingly small actions can have profound and lasting effects.) है।

Comprehension:निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़कर पूछे गए प्रश्नों के लिए सही विकल्प विकल्प चुनिए:हर बड़ा साहित्यकार साहित्य और विशेषकर शब्द की गरिमा और मर्यादा पर लड़ने-मरने को तैयार रहता है। बच्चन जी के साथ भी कुछ ऐसा ही है। बच्चन जी ने जितना आदर अपने साहित्य का किया, उतना ही भारत तथा विदेशों के साहित्य का भी किया। इसलिए समय-समय पर अनुवाद संबंधी नीति बनाते हुए उन्होंने भाषा की गरिमा बनाए रखने पर बहुत बल दिया। उनका कहना था कि अंग्रेज़ी का अनुवाद बाजारू स्तर की हिंदी में माँगना हिंदी के साथ अन्याय करना है। जब-जब हिंदी अंग्रेज़ी के स्तर तक उठने की कोशिश करती है, तो उस पर तुरंत दोष लगाया जाता है कि वह कठिन और क्लिष्ट है तथा जब वह उससे घबराकर अति सरलता की ओर जाती है, तो उसे अपरिपक्व कह दिया जाता है। बच्चन जी ने अपने गद्य और पद्य दोनों में ही एक सुंदर, सुगठित और सरल हिंदी का प्रयोग करके यह सिद्ध कर दिया कि आवश्यकता के अनुसार संस्कृत की ओर झुकती हिंदी भी लोकप्रिय और लोकरंजक हो सकती है। हरिवंश राय बच्चन प्रखर बुद्धि के कवि थे। उनकी भाषा शुद्ध साहित्यिक खड़ी बोली है। इन्होंने संस्कृत की तत्सम शब्दावली का अधिकता से प्रयोग किया है। इसके साथ-साथ तद्भव शब्दावली, उर्दू, फ़ारसी, अंग्रेज़ी आदि भाषाओं के शब्दों का भी प्रयोग हुआ है। कवि ने प्रांजल शैली का प्रयोग किया है, जिसके कारण इनका साहित्य लोकप्रिय हुआ है। इन्होंने लोकगीतों और मुक्तक छंदों की रचना भी की है। अपनी गेयता, सरलता, सरसता और खुलेपन के कारण इनके गीत बहुत ही पसंद किए जाते हैं।बच्चन जी के अनुसार किस प्रकार की हिंदी लोकप्रिय और लोकरंजक हो सकती है?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (संस्कृत की ओर झुकती हिंदी) है।

Comprehension:निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें-
परमाल रासो का रचयिता कवि जगनिक थे जिसे चंदेल वंशी राजा परमर्दिदेव का दरबारी कवि माना जाता है। आल्हा और ऊदल नामक दो क्षत्रिय सामंतों की वीरता का वर्णन परमाल रासो के अन्तर्गत प्रमुख रूप से किया गया है। उत्तर प्रदेश में इसे 'आल्हा' या 'आल्हखण्ड' के नाम से जाना जाता है तथा यह अपनी गेयता के कारण अब तक लोक-काव्य के रूप में समादृत है। आचार्य रामचन्द्र शुक्ल का मत है कि "जगनिक के काव्य का आज कहीं पता नहीं है पर, उसके आधार पर प्रचलित गीत, हिन्दी भाषा-भाषी प्रान्तों के गांव-गांव में सुनाई पड़ते हैं। ... यह गूंज मात्र है मूल शब्द नहीं "
परमाल रासो का रचना काल 13 वीं शताब्दी के प्रारम्भ में माना गया है। वीर भावना का जितना प्रौढ़ रूप इस ग्रन्थ में मिलता है, वैसा अन्यत्र दुर्लभ है। भावों के अनुरूप भाषा का प्रयोग इसकी अन्यतम विशेषता है। आज भी वर्षाकाल में उत्तर प्रदेश के गांव-गांव में आल्हा के स्वर सुने जा सकते हैं जो श्रोताओं के हृदय में वीर रस का संचार कर देते हैं। 'आल्ह खण्ड' नाम से चार्ल्स ईलिएट ने सर्वप्रथम इसका प्रकाशन कराया था जिसके आधार पर डॉ. श्यामसुन्दर दास ने 'परमाल रासो' का पाठ निर्धारण कर उसे नागरी प्रचारिणी सभा से प्रकाशित कराया। यद्यपि यह कृति सर्वथा प्रामाणिक़ नहीं है तथापि अपनी गेयता, वीर रस की मार्मिक अभिव्यक्ति के कारण आदिकाल की एक उल्लेखनीय कृति मानी जाती है।'प्रौढ़' का पर्यायवाची शब्द है-

options: देखने में अच्छा भला भीतर से दुखी

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में से ‘थोक’ का विलोम क्या है?

Comprehension:निम्नलिखित गद्यांश के आधार पर प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।भारत के अन्य राज्यों की तुलना में ओड़िशा अँग्रेज़-शासन के अधीनस्थ बहुत बाद में हुआ। यही कारण है कि शिक्षा का आधुनिक रूप भी ओड़िशा तक बहुत बाद में पहुँचा। सरकारी प्रयासों से सन् 1835 के नवम्बर माह में ‘पुरी' ज़िले में पहली बार अँग्रेज़ी विद्यालय स्थापित हुआ,जोकि हिंदु धर्मपीठ (जगन्नाथ धाम) होने के कारण जल्द ही बंद भी हो गया था। बंगाल एवं ओड़िशा भाषाई अलगाव रखते हुए भी एक ही औपनिवेशिक राज्य थे। अतः बंगाल नवजागरण का सीधा प्रभाव अन्य राज्यों की तुलना में पहले ओड़िशा पर ही पड़ा। बंगाल ब्रह्मसमाज की एक शाखा ‘उत्कालिय ब्रह्मसमाज’ के नाम से ‘बालेश्वर' में स्थापित हुई। जिसके माध्यम से पाश्चात्य शिक्षित उत्कलिय अपनी देश,जाति, धर्म, संस्कृति के उत्तरोत्तर उन्नति का विकास कार्य करने लगे। आगे चल कर ओड़िया भाषा अँग्रेज़ों व बंगाल के कुचक्रान्त की शिकार बनी। उनके द्वारा ओड़िया को बंगला से विकसित प्रमाणित कर मुलोत्पाटन करने की पुरज़ोर कोशिश हुई। इस कुत्सित चक्रान्त की परिणति यह हुई कि सरकार द्वारा 'ओड़िया भाषा द्वारा शिक्षादान' प्रत्याहार का आदेश पारित कर दिया गया।  इसके विरोध में ओड़िशा के शिक्षित वर्गों ने भी क्षुब्ध होकर आंदोलन छेड़ दिया। इस आंदोलन के पुरोधा बने उत्कल के वरपुत्र फ़क़ीर मोहन सेनापति। अंततः सरकार को भी सन्‌ 1870 में अपना आदेश प्रत्याहार करने के लिए बाध्य होना पड़ा    619ओड़िशा में पहला अंग्रेज़ी विद्यालय कब स्थापित हुआ था?620

Comprehension:दिए गये गद्यांश के आधार पर निम्नांकित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए-अक्सर दूरदर्शन पर परिवार नियोजन के कार्यक्रम और विज्ञापनों को लेकर सवाल उठाये जाते हैं कि ये विज्ञापन बच्चों पर बुरा असर डाल रहे हैं, बच्चों को समय से पहले प्रौढ़ बना रहे हैं। क्या सचमुच इस तरह के विज्ञापन समाज के लिए अहितकर हैं? यह तथ्य सभी एक स्वर में स्वीकृत करते हैं कि आज बढ़ती आबादी सबसे बड़ा संकट है परन्तु बढ़ती आबादी पर रोक के लिए कौन से कारगर उपाय किये जायें। यह चिंतन का बिंदु रहा है। निश्चय ही जनसंख्या पर नियन्त्रण में संचार माध्यमों द्वारा ज्ञापित सन्देश जनमानस में व्यापक असर डालते हैं। दूरदर्शन ने जब ठीक समाचारों के बाद परिवार को छोटा रखने तथा गर्भ निरोध के उपायों सम्बन्धी विज्ञापन दिखाना प्रारम्भ किया तब लोगों में यह हाय-तौबा मचाई कि टी.वी. बच्चों को बिगाड़ रहा है। कुछ लोगों ने इन विज्ञापनों की शब्दावली को लेकर आपत्ति जताई। यद्यपि उनके आरोप भी कुछ हद तक सही हैं परन्तु इस तरह की सूचनाएं हम बच्चों से छिपाकर कितनी देर रख सकते हैं? बच्चे धीरे-धीरे बड़े हो रहे हैं और उन्हें गर्भ निरोधक तथा परिवार –नियोजन सम्बन्धी सूचनाएं किसी न किसी स्रोत से प्राप्त हो ही जाती है।निम्नलिखित विकल्पों में से गद्यांश के केन्द्रीय विषय का चयन करें-
